title: Proving Ground
tagline: A test level: one station for every platformer feature of the engine
description: Walk, jump (coyote time, jump buffer, variable height), climb ladders, drop through catwalks, slide on ice, ride conveyor belts and moving platforms, bounce on springs, avoid spikes, float in a low-gravity room, swim and dive in a pool for coins, stomp or shoot patrolling slimes, dig through dirt, and blast a brick tower down. Every station is a feature of the Pixelite engine, and the level is checked with the engine's reach search.
controls: climb a ladder, drop through a catwalk, swim up or dive
throw a bomb (it blasts rock and bricks)
dig dirt in front of you
grappling hook: shoots toward the mouse, or up and forward; again lets go
stick or d-pad, A jump, X pebble, B bomb, Y dig, RB hook, LB rewind

gravity.label: Gravity
gravity.help: How hard everything falls. The low-gravity room halves it.

runSpeed.label: Run speed
runSpeed.help: Top speed of the hero on the ground (a base unit is half a metre).

jumpHeight.label: Jump height
jumpHeight.help: How high a full jump goes (hold the button; let go early for a short hop).

coyote.label: Coyote time
coyote.help: How long after running off a ledge a jump still counts.

buffer.label: Jump buffer
buffer.help: How long before landing a jump press is remembered.

wallJump.label: Wall jump
wallJump.help: 1: slide down walls and jump off them.

daylight.label: Day and night
daylight.help: 1: the sun, the shadows, the sky, the stars and the ambient light follow the clock (setTimeOfDay). The torches burn brighter at night.

hour.label: Hour
hour.help: The time of day when the clock is on: 12 is noon, 6 sunrise, 18 sunset. The sun climbs from the left and sets on the right, so the shadows swing.

dayRate.label: Day speed
dayRate.help: Hours of game time a second the clock runs by itself (0: it stands still at the hour above).

weather.label: Weather
weather.help: Rain cools what it hits and splashes into the pool; snow drifts and piles up on the ground as cells (they are in the hero's way).

wind.label: Wind
wind.help: Blows the rain and snow, the smoke and the dust, and leans the grass. Negative blows left.

fog.label: Fog
fog.help: A mist thickest near the ground, thicker still over the hills and the sky.

look.label: Screen look
look.help: 1 locks the picture to four greens with a dither; 2 adds scanlines and a strong vignette.
